title: Math Driver
style: French heist rap fused with hyper-speed 90s R&B bounce; frantic syncopated drums, rubbery bass, clipped rim shots, and a sleek groove that tightens in verses, strips to handclaps and a filtered chant pre-chorus, then slams into a hook with stacked doubles and gang vocals. Add siren-like risers, reversed swells into the chorus, and quick tape-stop flicks between lines. Bright, punchy, and clean in the mix, with intimate lead vocals and shouted ad-libs on the hook., r&b, fake, bounce, rock
lyrics:
[Intro]
Math Driver
Delta alpha, plan
Hyperspeed, j’ai
I can, you got this

[Verse 1]
Unit 336, j’passe la grille
Fausse alarme, faux départ, vrai style
Polly dans la hood, capuche au vent
On casse les codes, pas les gens
Cash back drop, ça fait choque
Chase and cage, on retourne le bloc
Mes boys thrash ce jouet, vite fait
Prends la bonne voie, garde le trajet
Sirens sound, j’garde mon calme
Le plan dans la tête, la paix dans l’âme

[Pre-Chorus]
Math Driver, on trace la ligne
Delta alpha, tout s’aligne
Herses, murs, on les franchit
Free birds rock, nuit finie
Je vois l’issue, j’vois le signal
On tient la pulse, on reste royal

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in a hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in the hood
But it’s for good

[Verse 2]
Heres my boys, thrash this toy
On prend la main, on prend le toit
Take the right lane, hyper speed plane
Police chatter, mais j’entends peine
J’fake a break, je sors du cadre
Extra stripe, zéro drame
You heard the sarg, chase and cage
On fait plier leur petit manège
Thrift drift kick, j’glisse en silence
Phonky sneaky phonk, belle cadence
Math Driver, l’architecte
Le rêve en marche, la route est nette

[Pre-Chorus]
Math Driver, on trace la ligne
Delta alpha, tout s’aligne
Herses, murs, on les franchit
Free birds rock, nuit finie
Je vois l’issue, j’vois le signal
On tient la pulse, on reste royal

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in a hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in the hood
But it’s for good

[Bridge]
One, two, trois, respire
Trois miroirs, fais-les mentir
A robin, a robin, out the mansion
On fend la nuit, on change la version
No rage, pas d’ombre sur le front
On sort clean, on sort bon
Our robin, our robin, our robin in our hood
Désormais safe, sound, understood

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in a hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in the hood
But it’s for good
